note: BH-10274: the runner a triage shard retries on after a runner fault. Empty (default) = claude, or codex when claude was the runner that failed. A value that is not ^[a-z0-9_-]+$ or that names the failed runner reads as empty. Code fallback in rf_other_runner. NOT settable from the control plane: it names a runner a root lane executes (tests/lanes-registry-test.sh 17a); set it in the box env only.
